image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) resting on grass in front of a textured stone wall. The duck displays characteristic breeding plumage with an iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey-brown body. It has a yellow-green bill and dark eyes. The legs are tucked under the body and not visible.
